purpose: Resolve the contradiction between the official GWTC-5 PE notebook and the released PESummaryTable numeric encoding before deciding whether any new candidate-frame numerical analysis is scientifically defensible.

candidate_confirmatory_frame.source: the previously frozen 22-event B07-U03 alternate-triad frame

selected_out_of_frame_event.selection_basis: First lexicographic Part-1 event outside the frozen 22-event candidate frame with file size below 150000000 bytes and a previously registered IMRPhenomXPHM-SpinTaylor summary label. Selection used only official file metadata and the existing identity register, not numeric summary or posterior values.

allowed_numeric_access.quantile_method: numpy.quantile method=linear after retaining finite samples
forbidden: Any posterior element from the frozen 22-event candidate frame
Any inter-model distance or Wasserstein response
Any candidate-frame predictor, correlation or p-value

adjudication_rule.endpoint_encoding: summary lower approximately equals posterior q05 and summary upper approximately equals posterior q95
adjudication_rule.asymmetric_error_encoding: summary lower approximately equals median-q05 and summary upper approximately equals q95-median
adjudication_rule.comparison_tolerance: absolute <= 1e-8 or relative <= 1e-6 for each finite field
adjudication_rule.go_condition_for_new_design_consideratio: All five fields support one encoding consistently and the encoding permits a semantically explicit predictor fixed before any candidate posterior access.
adjudication_rule.stop_condition: Ambiguous or mixed encoding, source identity failure, missing required field, or any need to inspect a candidate-frame posterior to resolve semantics.

run01_effect: RUN01 remains a valid frozen-contract NO_GO and is not repaired or reclassified.
